summary: artifact-cleanup.sh is well-structured with proper `set -euo pipefail`, input validation, and quoting throughout; workflow uses pinned actions (v4), minimal permissions, and env-var injection for testing. Minor: the sortable-building pattern (lines 113–116, 141–144) repeats similar TSV construction with different sort keys; could extract a helper. Missing from deliverable: (1) explicit actionlint validation in run-act-tests.sh despite spec requiring WORKFLOW STRUCTURE TESTS; (2) visibility into bats test file and fixture TSV files, though workflow references them. Assuming these exist per spec, script quality is high—good error handling, TDD-friendly (fixtures, --now, --dry-run), readable comments, clear seams. act integration is correct.
